heading: RUN-OFF ELECTION: November 3rd, 2026
text: Patricia Rumph for Orange County Commissioner District 7 A Stronger Community Starts with its People.

heading: Meet Patricia
text: For more than 30 years, Rumph served the State of Florida in the Florida Department of Corrections, retiring in 2017 after a career that included roles as a Correctional Probation Senior Officer, Human Resources Specialist, and Fiscal Assistant. Her work focused on public safety, rehabilitation, workforce development, budgeting, and supporting individuals and families during some of their most difficult moments. Patricia Rumph also served as President of the Pine Hills Community Council, while also serving on multiple county boards.

heading: Priorities for District 7
text: Focused on building a safer, more connected, and sustainable Orange County.

heading: Public Safety
text: I believe every family deserves to feel safe in their homes and neighborhoods. Whether it's partnering with local law enforcement to reduce crime, supporting violence prevention programs, or improving emergency services, I'll work tirelessly to ensure our neighborhoods are safe places.

heading: Strong Infrastructure
text: I am committed to building a better Orange County where our roads, public transportation, and community facilities meet the needs of our growing population. This means improving road safety, modernizing public transit, and ensuring our infrastructure keeps pace with our residents' needs.

heading: Affordable Housing
text: Everyone should have access to an affordable place to call home. I'll work to increase accessible housing options and ensure new developments are responsibly planned. A stronger community is one where families can afford to live.

heading: Environmental Stewardship
text: Protecting our environment is about ensuring a healthy Orange County for generations to come. I will champion responsible growth policies, conservation of our natural resources, and initiatives that reduce pollution and safeguard our water sources.

heading: Introduction
text: Patricia Rumph is a lifelong Orange County resident with over 30 years of service, dedicated to strengthening communities and building a safer future for District 7.

heading: Youth
text: Patricia Rumph believes mentorship shapes strong futures, guiding youth with structure, support, and opportunity to help them grow, succeed, and thrive in Orange County

heading: Housing
text: Patricia Rumph supports affordable housing and responsible development, ensuring working families, seniors, and essential workers can live, work, and thrive in the communities they serve.

heading: Crime
text: Patricia Rumph focuses on violence prevention, youth intervention, and stronger community trust, working to reduce crime, improve emergency response, and build safer neighborhoods.

heading: Small Business
text: Patricia Rumph supports small businesses by expanding opportunity, reducing barriers, and streamlining processes to help entrepreneurs grow and strengthen the local economy.

heading: Environmental
text: Patricia Rumph is committed to protecting waterways, preserving green space, and ensuring clean, safe, and sustainable environments for future generations across Orange County.

heading: Safety Workforce
text: Patricia Rumph supports public safety professionals and essential workers by prioritizing training, mental health, and fair pay for those who serve and protect our community every day.

heading: Transparency
text: Patricia Rumph is committed to transparency, accountability, and responsible planning, ensuring community voices are heard and delivering results that serve the people of District 7.

heading: Infrastructure
text: Patricia Rumph supports investing in infrastructure that keeps pace with growth, focusing on transportation, drainage, and smart planning to protect families for a safer, more resilient OCFL.

heading: Reentry & Training
text: Patricia Rumph supports workforce training and second-chance opportunities, helping individuals become productive citizens, reduce recidivism, and build safer communities across OCFL.
